meta.title: Synthetic Error Budget Program
meta.scope: Artificial multi-operation QPU example / UX laboratory
meta.disclaimer: Artificial demonstration data only. No Pasqal data is used. Values, teams, evidence links and decisions are synthetic.

semantics.budget_definition: allowed_error_pp is the maximum operation infidelity implied by the synthetic target fidelity
semantics.decomposition_definition: each contributor is expressed as a share of the current operation infidelity; residual unattributed error is explicitly represented as Unknown / Unassigned
semantics.composition_warning: Additivity is a synthetic first-order approximation for this UX prototype, not a universal scientific law. A production system must use a versioned operation-specific composition method.

live.meaning: Latest generated technical state; may include changes since the last formal close.

accepted.meaning: Latest state containing only reviewed and accepted contributions.

closed.meaning: Frozen synthetic monthly close used as the previous reference.
